title: Prefix-named phases command contract declaration (positive fixture)
description: Positive fixture: a conforming command contract declaration whose framework phases are prefix-named — 'prepared' (a prefix of the reserved 'prepare') and 'verify-notes' (a prefix of the reserved 'verify'). A prefix of a reserved phase name is not a collision: the reserved-name rule rejects only a full-token collision with the reserved phase names prepare, configure, verify, promote (case-insensitive, command-contract.md §4.2); the phaseSequence pattern bounds the reserved-name rejection to complete tokens. Verification checks, config extensions, and templates declare nothing; the full exchange rule set C1–C7 plus the declared-surface bound is affirmed.

lifecyclePhases.description: A framework phase whose name starts with the reserved word 'prepare' but does not collide with it.
